Package me.pagar.api

Interface PagarmeApiSDKClientInterface

All Superinterfaces:
Configuration
All Known Implementing Classes:
PagarmeApiSDKClient
public interface PagarmeApiSDKClientInterface extends Configuration
Gateway interface for the library. This acts as a factory for Controllers. It holds the state of the SDK.
